p_ql1: Fine‑tuned an 8B Llama 3.1 model with QLoRA (4‑bit, Unsloth, TRL), training 0.52% of parameters on a 15 GB GPU, raising answer completion from 32% to 52% and exact‑answer accuracy from 16.2% to 27.3% on 99 NuminaMath problems.
